sections.subhead: Keeping a Live Site Secure, Fast, and Actually Working

body.html: Teknoppy's WordPress care plans keep Kochi business sites updated, backed up and secure. We test core, theme and plugin updates on staging, keep daily off-site backups, monitor uptime and security around the clock, fix issues within the plan and send a plain-language report every month. Plans start from Rs. 5,000/month.

Not on WordPress? See our website maintenance services for other frameworks. For WordPress sites, a dedicated care plan prevents downtime, broken checkouts, and security vulnerabilities before they impact revenue.

ctas.label: Book a Free Site Health Check

items.title: Core, Theme & Plugin Updates
items.html: Outdated plugins are the most common way WordPress sites get compromised. Updates run on a fixed schedule and are tested on staging before deployment so an update never breaks your live site.

items.title: Daily Backups & Verified Restore
items.html: Daily automated backups stored securely off-server with verified restore capability, giving you a reliable safety net if anything ever fails.

items.title: Security & Malware Monitoring
items.html: We watch your site around the clock for malware, brute-force logins and unexpected file changes, and act before customers notice.

items.title: 24/7 Uptime Monitoring
items.html: Continuous automated uptime monitoring checks your site every 5 minutes. If downtime occurs, our engineers are alerted immediately to restore availability.

items.title: Site Health Audit
items.text: Before onboarding, we review current plugin versions, backup status, and any existing vulnerabilities so we know exactly what state the site is in.

items.title: Plan Setup
items.text: Daily backups, security monitoring, and uptime checks are switched on from day one, matched to one of our WordPress care plans Kochi businesses typically choose based on site size and traffic.

items.title: Scheduled Updates
items.text: Core, theme, and plugin updates are tested on staging first, then pushed live on a fixed schedule rather than an ad-hoc basis.

items.title: Ongoing Troubleshooting
items.text: Any broken layout, plugin conflict, or error is handled as part of WordPress bug fixing and troubleshooting, included in the plan rather than billed separately.

items.title: Monthly Reporting
items.text: You get a plain-language summary of what was updated, checked, and fixed that month, so maintenance isn't a black box.
Your site was built by a freelancer or agency no longer available to support it
You have had a plugin conflict, broken layout, or unplanned downtime in the past year
You run ecommerce or lead-generation where even a few hours offline costs revenue
You want a predictable monthly care plan instead of paying emergency hourly rates
You have never had formal maintenance and are unsure what state your backups or security are in

outro.text: This is also the right service for businesses whose site sees regular traffic from outside Kerala — including GCC clients — where downtime during off-hours for you can still mean lost enquiries somewhere else. A site that isn't maintained doesn't fail all at once; it degrades gradually through slower load times, small visual bugs, and growing security gaps until one of them causes real damage.

outro.html: If your need is closer to a one-time fix than ongoing support, our WordPress Speed Optimization page covers that separately. If your site needs custom functionality built first, see Custom WordPress Development Kochi.

Businesses considering WordPress Maintenance Services Kochi usually fall into one of these categories rather than needing a full rebuild — which is why a short site health check comes before any quote.

paragraphs.html: Teknoppy manages ongoing WordPress maintenance for businesses across Kochi and Kerala — from small business sites to ecommerce stores — each on a monitored update and backup schedule. See related work in our Website Projects Portfolio.

WordPress maintenance at Teknoppy typically ranges from Rs. 5,000 to Rs. 15,000 per month. sections.h2: Frequently Asked Questions — WordPress Maintenance Services Kochi

items.q: What does WordPress maintenance service include?
items.a: It includes scheduled core, theme, and plugin updates tested on staging, daily off-site backups, continuous security scanning, 24/7 uptime checks, bug fixes within the plan, and a monthly health report.

items.q: How much does WordPress maintenance cost in Kochi?
items.a: WordPress maintenance in Kochi typically costs between Rs. 5,000 and Rs. 15,000 a month with Teknoppy, depending on site size, traffic and whether it is a WooCommerce store. Every plan includes staged updates, daily off-site backups, security and uptime monitoring and a monthly report.

items.q: Can you maintain a WordPress site another developer built?
items.a: Yes. Most sites on our care plans were built by other developers or agencies. We start with a comprehensive site health and security audit to check plugin versions, hosting quality, and database health before onboarding.

items.q: Is there a minimum contract period?
items.a: Our WordPress care plans run month to month with no long-term lock-in. You can upgrade, pause, or cancel with 30 days notice.

items.q: What do you do if our WordPress site is hacked?
items.a: If an active care-plan site is compromised, we immediately restore from clean daily off-site backups, isolate vulnerable plugins, clear malware, and patch access vectors at no extra charge.

items.q: How often should a WordPress site be updated?
items.a: Security patches should be applied immediately when released. Plugin and theme updates are typically reviewed and tested on staging monthly as part of a standard update cycle.

sections.h2: Ready to Stop Firefighting Your Website?

paragraphs.text: An unmaintained WordPress site doesn't fail all at once — it degrades through slow load times, small errors, and security gaps until one of them costs you a customer. Teknoppy's WordPress support services Kochi team handles the ongoing work so your site stays fast, secure, and online.
